policies.sentence: Students should learn to develop code and apply fundamental concepts on their own, treating AI as scaffolding.
Students may use AI only after Project 4 and Exam 1, and must work independently.
Fundamentals must be mastered before relying on AI, and unaided programming remains a core learning goal.
AI works best for skilled coders, and judging AI output takes experience.
Novice learners may be harmed rather than helped by AI, and prompting is easy to learn later.
